dominant_color_description: Deep earthy red-brown background with slightly darker rust-colored circular geometric accents.
legibility_reason: High-contrast white sans-serif text against the dark brown background makes the copy extremely sharp and easy to read.
layout_notes: Centered clean layout with geometric circle elements in the top left and bottom right corners. The color scheme focuses on earthy tones rather than vibrant warm summer coral or yellows.

per_criterion.evidence: The palette relies heavily on deep earthy brown and rust tones rather than warm vibrant summer tones like coral, amber, or bright yellow.
Clean sans-serif typography with excellent white-on-dark contrast and clear visual hierarchy.

reasoning: The banner features clean legible typography but fails the summer palette rubric due to its dark earthy brown color scheme.
